NAME: HONEYWELL INTERNATIONAL INC
REASON: Old (pre-2026) Honeywell CUSIP. Honeywell did a 1-for-2 reverse stock split + Aerospace spin-off effective 2026-06-29, which issued a new CUSIP (438516205, already resolvable via OpenFIGI directly). OpenFIGI's data for the old CUSIP only returns currency-denominated variants (HONGBP, HONEUR, HONGBX, HONRUB), none clean US-listed -- verified via a direct query on 2026-08-15. Both the old and new CUSIP are mapped to the same ticker here since this crosswalk is a static snapshot, not a CUSIP genealogy; holdings reported under either CUSIP resolve to the same equity.

NAME: MEDTRONIC PLC
REASON: Old Medtronic Inc CUSIP (pre-2015). Medtronic redomiciled from the US to Ireland in 2015 (became Medtronic plc), issuing a new CUSIP (G5960L103, already resolvable via OpenFIGI directly). OpenFIGI returns no data at all for the old CUSIP ("No identifier found." warning, verified 2026-08-15) -- it isn't in OpenFIGI's database, so this override is sourced from public SEC-filing history (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/64670/000119312517090123/d359917d424b3.htm) rather than an OpenFIGI query.

NAME: META PLATFORMS INC
REASON: Current ticker for Facebook/Meta's CUSIP (unchanged since IPO -- this is a pure ticker rename, not a CUSIP change). Listed alongside the FB alias row below because load_cusip_ticker_map() has overrides fully supersede the base map's single row for a CUSIP -- both rows must be present here or the base map's "META" row would be lost entirely, not merged with the alias.

NAME: FACEBOOK INC
REASON: Facebook's ticker before its 2022 corporate rename to Meta Platforms (same CUSIP 30303M102, confirmed via direct OpenFIGI query on 2026-08-15 -- current query returns only "META", never "FB"). Needed so universe.sp500_members() can resolve S&P 500 membership history rows dated before the rename, which still list the constituent as "FB". This is illustrative of a broader, disclosed limitation: OpenFIGI reflects only a security's CURRENT ticker, so any company that renamed, was acquired, or delisted during the 2013-2026 backtest window may not resolve under its historical ticker label without a similar override -- not comprehensively patched here (would be re-deriving a full historical ticker genealogy, out of scope), only demonstrated for this and the BK/BNY case below.

NAME: BNY
REASON: Current ticker for Bank of New York Mellon Corp's CUSIP (unchanged) -- the company changed its ticker from "BK" to "BNY" effective 2026-05-21 as part of a corporate rebrand to just "BNY" (pure ticker rename, not a CUSIP change). Listed alongside the BK alias row below for the same reason as the META/FB pair above.

NAME: BANK OF NEW YORK MELLON CORP
REASON: BNY Mellon's ticker before its 2026-05-21 rebrand to "BNY" (same CUSIP 064058100). Needed so universe.sp500_members() can resolve S&P 500 membership history rows dated before 2026-05-21, which list the constituent as "BK" -- the vast majority of the 2013-2026 backtest window, since the rename happened only 3 months before this crosswalk was built.
